meta.title: What if listening well does not change their mind? | Prayer for the One I Cannot Persuade
meta.description:
A spoken prayer for the person you could not persuade. It offers plain words for keeping their account true, and for letting a disagreement stand.

For Election Day, and any day people who disagree must choose together. It keeps listening and dignity close, and lets the difference stand.

A prayer for disagreement that remains after honest listening, asking for accuracy, restraint, and care without requiring agreement or renewed trust.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/prayer-for-the-one-i-cannot-persuade

copy.alt: A small gold and white light hangs in a deep indigo void, with one thin thread rising. Two great lattices of fine circles overlap, turned slightly apart, while a dim rose point sits low and still. Then a vast white and gold radiance fills the upper frame and lights both lattices evenly. Soft ripples spread from the small light across a still, mirror dark surface.
